svg.title: Lighting VTT — Three ways to light the adventure
svg.desc: Three original vector icon directions: Lightling, Revealed Table, and Lightbend. Each is shown in color and monochrome on light and dark backgrounds at 16, 24, 32, 48, and 128 pixels.

g.text: Three ways to light the adventure.
Original vector marks. Distinct personalities. Built to work small.
01 / A LITTLE LIGHT. A LOT OF CHARACTER.
A flame spirit for adventures after dark.
02 / BRING THE MAP INTO THE LIGHT.
A tabletop revealed, one beam at a time.
An L, a prism, and a beam in motion.
